owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Envelope specification: fields, versioning, deterministic serialisation, hash rules
requirements: MV-INT-02: One canonical operation envelope with versioned schema and deterministic serialisation: origin identity and node, operation id, causal dependencies, project and object id, type and payload, authorisation evidence, contract or policy reference, content hash, verification status (P0). (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:41; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:87; baseline 8.5)
SO-1.04 requirement 3: "Distinguish a requested action, an accepted dispatch, an observed execution and a verified outcome in the event history." (source: contract SO-1.04 T1)

A change to the envelope format needs a new version or magic, keeps the old decoder, and has a change-log entry; a silent change to the pinned fingerprint of a fixed envelope is a defect (source: the wire-compatibility policy of acfa-rs COMPATIBILITY.md, Apache-2.0, cited as the model; repository analysis of 1 Nov 2026, section 4 item A2)

Every envelope carries a hash of the merge contract it ran under (strategy, mapping version, policy fields); a mismatch is refused with a signal and never merged silently across versions (source: the merge-DNA gate of converge src/gates.py and tests/test_gates.py, described only; repository analysis of 1 Nov 2026, section 3.4 item C1)

SO-F-03 (signed fold contract, cited by id; pull request #341) owns the signature and admission block, the per-sender sequence and the rejected event on top of the operation envelope of PG-04.1, with two-step admission; this task cites it and does not restate it (source: pull request #341, WBS.md section 9.2)

SO-F-12 (signed fold contract, cited by id; pull request #341) owns the per-scope operation-log streams, the split of the operation log and the two-node check that a local-only item never reaches the peer; this task cites it and does not restate it (source: pull request #341, WBS.md section 9.2)
tasks.description: Repo: memev. Fields from the notes: origin identity and node, operation id, causal dependencies, project and object id, type and payload, authorisation evidence, contract or policy reference, content hash, verification status. Resolve ADR 2 (id and event ordering) in the same change. The document states the wire-compatibility policy and the merge-contract hash. The converge pattern is cited and described only: converge is BUSL-1.1 and no code is copied (counsel review is WP15-03). Boundary with the fold: this document defines the one envelope and reserves one optional extension block that the content hash covers. SO-F-03 adds the signature and admission block, the per-sender sequence and the rejected event on top of it, so none of those fields is defined here; SO-F-12 adds scope and classification to the same envelope for stream records and defines no second record format. The envelope stays here and is not trimmed.

criteria.statement: spec exists
spec names the verification status field
The specification states the wire-compatibility policy (new version, old decoder kept, fingerprint, change log) and the merge-contract hash with its refusal

verifier.cmd: for n in "new version" "old decoder" fingerprint "change log" merge_contract_hash refused; do grep -qi "$n" docs/OPERATION-ENVELOPE.md || exit 1; done

criteria.statement: The specification reserves an extension block and names SO-F-03 and SO-F-12 as the contracts that extend the envelope

verifier.cmd: for n in "extension block" "SO-F-03" "SO-F-12"; do grep -qi "$n" docs/OPERATION-ENVELOPE.md || exit 1; done

criteria.statement: The specification has no section that defines the signature and admission block, the per-sender sequence or the rejected event, which are SO-F-03

verifier.cmd: ! grep -Eqi '^#+ .*(signature block|admission block|per-sender sequence|rejected event)' docs/OPERATION-ENVELOPE.md

criteria.statement: Changes stay in scope

title: PG-04.2 Canonical operation envelope (memev)
request: Version 2 of PG-04: it supersedes PG-04.1 (signed as contract k-pg-04-1-canonical-operat-b77c7c; the PG-04.1 file is unchanged and stays on record, and the manifest and RECONCILIATION mark it superseded by this contract; owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026). Reason: pull request #357 builds WP04-01 and WP04-02: it must link docs/OPERATION-ENVELOPE.md from docs/README.md so that the docs-links test passes, and it must map src/engine/envelope.mjs into docs/MODULES.md; pull request #366 builds WP04-03 and WP04-04 and also changes docs/MODULES.md. docs/MODULES.md is generated by scripts/docs/module-graph.mjs and checked by a docs test, and PG-04.1 lists neither path. This contract adds docs/README.md to the scope of WP04-01 and docs/MODULES.md to the scope of WP04-02, WP04-03 and WP04-04, and nothing else: no other scope entry, requirement, criterion or stop rule changes. Programme contract for work package WP04 in memev: Canonical operation envelope. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP04.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP17-03. Depends on contracts: SO-1.04, SO-1.01. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-1.04 and SO-1.01: WP04 depends on both: the envelope carries the four-way event distinction of SO-1.04 requirement 3 and does not define the adapter contract (SO-1.04 requirement 1) or own the store or coordinator (SO-1.01). Boundary with SO-2.07 to SO-2.11: their adapter layers must use canonical operation contracts: the WP04 envelope is that contract, and these specs do not define any adapter for those systems. Build layer (owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026): the signed fold contracts SO-F-03, SO-F-12 (cited by id; delivered by pull request #341, WBS.md section 9.2 on its branch) are the build layer. Each task below that overlaps them cites the fold id and keeps only what the fold does not cover. Tasks of this spec that name no fold contract have no fold overlap. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
